text: A bald man with a white beard and mustache, appearing middle-aged to elderly. His face is angular, eyes narrowed in intensity. He wears a sleeveless red top with gold circular necklaces and large gold hoop earrings. His posture is upright, facing slightly right. Behind him looms a shadowy figure with a mask-like face. The setting is dark, suggesting an interior space with muted purple and brown tones.
